presentation.title: Messages connection

rows.title: Messages account
rows.detail: Sign in with Apple inside Messages. ARL never asks for your Apple password. Account confirmation and the message test are separate.

rows.title: Mac permissions
rows.detail: Receive access and Automation → Messages belong to the actual Messages bridge. Refresh only reads permission evidence.

rows.title: Allowed group
rows.detail: Only the group and participants you review are allowed. Listing group metadata needs separate permission.

rows.title: Test messages
rows.detail: One agreed test send and two new participant messages. Command acceptance alone is not delivery. No automatic resend.

rows.title: Mio connection
rows.detail: Test text goes to the existing organization-scoped Mio/OpenAI transport. This is not a personal-exclusive conversation. Subscription or HTTP acceptance does not prove consumption.

rows.title: While the Mac is locked
rows.detail: Normal authorized operations have no unlocked-screen requirement. Sleep, logout, reboot and first FileVault unlock are separate conditions.

actions.label: Set up Messages
actions.reason: Responsible Messages host is not installed.
